topic: Explicit known-zero reference inputs versus missing retained facts, 2026-09-28

facts.value: AToken balance evaluation calls normalized income before applying the selected ray multiplication. A numeric zero index is not a missing-input marker.
facts.note: AToken.sol lines 133-138, TokenMath.sol lines 66-71, WadRayMath.sol lines 64-83. Equal-time normalization returns the stored zero; a later time still executes linear interest and can fail before multiplying by zero. The host reference must preserve that execution order.

facts.value: SavingsDai resolves stored or projected chi before conversions. A known zero can produce zero assets; floor conversion to shares must reject a zero divisor, including when the asset amount is zero.
facts.note: PreviewMint lines 305-309 and previewWithdraw lines 321-325 resolve chi first too. Projection failures remain failures even if chi or the requested amount is zero. Previously chi=RAY, dsr=0, rho=100 and timestamp=101 produced numeric zero and caused a Rust BigUint division panic in convert_to_shares. It now returns Unknown::Invalid.

facts.value: SavingsDai _divup returns zero when its numerator is zero before evaluating division. Thus previewWithdraw(0) returns zero with known chi zero after any required projection succeeds; a positive numerator with zero chi fails.
facts.note: The host helper is used only by SavingsDai. This branch order does not change other vault implementations' rounding helpers.

facts.value: Complete explicit zero facts and positive or known-zero holder inputs evaluate through synthetic blocks 10-11 and undo. Removing the index, chi, dsr or rho fact remains MissingInput under the retained bridge's complete-input policy.
facts.source_pin: repository regression tests for the pinned models above
facts.note: Synthetic exact checkpoints initialize one observed holder per case; no absent write is initialized as zero. Pure failures and the prior panic were reproduced in out/known-zero-reference-20260928/01-red-tests.log, with source hashes retained. An intermediate test ownership compile failure remains in 02-focused-tests.log.

open_questions: These are source-branch regressions for explicitly supplied numbers, not evidence that zero indices or chi were observed or are reachable on a qualified deployment.
No new runtime, package, getter, initialized global-holder or live-chain qualification is supplied; historical evidence retains its original artifact and interval scope.
